boundary_decision.rationale: The root is a persistent versioned proposition with its own identity and evaluation contract. Studies and assessments occur around it but do not turn the proposition itself into an event.

decisions.rationale: The model owns a provisional proposition and evaluation contract rather than study execution or a global truth judgment.
Hypothesis specializes an evaluable provisional proposition, but the canonical inheritance relation requires joint review.
Research question, assumption, prediction, theory, model, objective, requirement and generic claim remain independently identified.
Null, alternative, directional, equivalence and noninferiority structures apply only where the evaluation method declares them.
Constructs, measures, estimands, predictions and potential falsifiers require explicit scope and source.
The frozen prospective plan, amendments and post-registration deviations remain independently time-stamped.
Studies and evidence support, challenge, refute or leave a hypothesis inconclusive through explicit criteria and uncertainty.
P-values, intervals, Bayes factors, peer review, citation counts and authority do not create a context-free truth or policy decision.
Agents may append low-risk formulations and validations but not perform protected research, publication claims or destructive actions without authority.

decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet attempt timed out and one bounded Grok attempt failed with stderr suppressed and hashed. Codex separately audits the frozen validated result and comparison without acquiring new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet attempt timed out and one Grok attempt failed before producing an admissible result; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-KNW-007 remains a reference rather than an approved parent until joint boundary review.
Boundary hold: claims, assumptions, theories, questions, studies, protocols, tests, data, observations, results, evidence, publications and decisions remain external masters.
Profile hold: scientific, statistical, causal, qualitative, engineering, clinical, social-science and machine-learning hypotheses require discipline-specific semantics.
Inference hold: rejection, non-rejection, support, corroboration, refutation, replication, practical importance, causality and truth remain distinct assessments.
Method hold: statistical and Bayesian measures require declared estimand, assumptions, analysis, uncertainty, multiplicity and decision criteria.
Preregistration hold: prospective registration, amendments, deviations and later results require verified clocks and immutable lineage.
Ethics hold: human-subject, sensitive-data, dual-use, privacy, consent, publication and jurisdictional rules require accountable review.
Interoperability hold: NIST, ISO, JCGM, trial, OBI, STATO, ECO, W3C, DataCite, RO-Crate, Schema.org and FAIR projections require exact release pins, conformance tests and semantic-loss declarations.
Completeness hold: the 24-source draft is broad but does not claim universal disciplinary, philosophical, statistical, ethical, legal or operational coverage.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
